critical_code_review_comments: RoomPage.jsx is 716 lines — consider splitting (recording, PTT bar, participant tile, connect/disconnect) into hooks/components for maintainability.

In refreshParticipants (line ~91), the fallback to p.trackPublications for audio detection is fine but audioTrackPublications is the correct primary source — the defensive Array.from with .values?.() correctly handles both Map and Object shapes.

Owner-created seed users (bob.ops, alice.ops) did NOT exist before this iteration — I created them via the platform API. The RoomPage.jsx fix (defensive Map/Object iteration + trailing setTimeout refreshParticipants at 400/1200ms + ConnectionStateChanged=Connected refresh) is working. All 3 perspectives correctly count 3 tiles. Bug is resolved.
rca of the issue: Original bug (user seeing only admin tile) was caused by refreshParticipants being called only once at connect() resolution, before LiveKit populated room.remoteParticipants. Fix adds trailing refreshes at 400ms and 1200ms and on ConnectionStateChanged=Connected/Reconnected, so late-populated remote participants are captured. Verified via live 3-context Playwright test on real LiveKit Cloud.
